title: Program Optimization and Evaluation
summary: This module provides advanced teleprompters (optimizers) for DSPy programs, along with tools for evaluating their performance and proposing optimized instructions. It encompasses strategies for iterative prompt refinement, few-shot example selection, reinforcement learning, and meta-optimization, ensuring robust and efficient program development.

nodes.label: Program Optimizers (Teleprompters)
nodes.title: DSPy Program Optimizers
nodes.description: A collection of advanced optimizers that employ various strategies like iterative prompt refinement, few-shot example selection, reinforcement learning, and meta-optimization to enhance DSPy program performance.

nodes.label: Evaluation Metrics
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Provides a suite of metrics for evaluating DSPy programs, including traditional exact-match/F1 scores and advanced LLM-based metrics for semantic F1, completeness, and groundedness.

nodes.label: Program Instruction Proposers
nodes.title: DSPy Program Proposers
nodes.description: Tools for analyzing datasets and language model programs, generating observations, and proposing optimized instructions for individual modules within a program.

nodes.label: Optimization Utility Functions
nodes.title: DSPy Optimization Utilities
nodes.description: Helper functions for monitoring and evaluating program optimization trials, including inspecting model execution history, logging token usage, and calculating program quality over time.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Program Module
nodes.description: The core DSPy program (a dspy.Module instance) that is being optimized or evaluated.

nodes.label: Datasets (Train/Dev)
nodes.title: DSPy Datasets
nodes.description: Collections of examples used for training, development, and evaluation of DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: External Language Model
nodes.description: The underlying large language model that DSPy programs interact with, used by optimizers and evaluators.

groups.label: Optimization Strategies
groups.title: DSPy Program Optimization
groups.description: This group encompasses various teleprompters and optimizers designed to automatically improve the performance of DSPy programs through techniques like prompt engineering, few-shot learning, and reinforcement learning.

groups.label: Evaluation & Analysis
groups.title: Program Evaluation and Monitoring
groups.description: Components for assessing the quality of DSPy programs using diverse metrics and utilities for monitoring optimization trials, tracking performance, and debugging.

groups.label: Instruction Generation
groups.title: Automated Instruction Proposal
groups.description: Tools that analyze program structure and datasets to automatically propose and refine instructions for language models, aiding in the optimization process.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: Core DSPy & External Systems
groups.description: Represents the core DSPy program being worked on, the datasets used for training and evaluation, and the underlying language models that power the operations within this module.
